title: Add browser smoke suite for login and dashboard
description: Create a repeatable browser smoke suite for unauthenticated login, session establishment, localized protected dashboard, health/static loading, and logout.
acceptanceCriteria: The suite starts from a disposable local app/test database and never uses real credentials
Login success/failure, protected-route redirect, session refresh, dashboard load, and logout are asserted
Required static JS/CSS/media assets load without 404/MIME failures
The suite runs headlessly in CI or has a documented reproducible manual command and evidence file

steps.details: Create a browser fixture that starts the app/test server, navigates to en/fa login, and asserts the current expected flow; run it before UI fixes.
Seed a test user with a generated password held only in process memory/fixture environment; do not write it to evidence or source.
Check URL transitions, authenticated dashboard content, logout, console/page errors, and local static asset responses.
Run the smoke suite against the local/staged app and save sanitized pass/fail evidence.

technicalNotes: The repository currently has no Playwright package; add one only if the project chooses to make browser tests automated, otherwise use the installed browser runner and document the gate.
